# CareerFlow Repository Instructions

`AGENTS.md` is the canonical instruction file for this repository. Read it before making changes.

Before modifying a capability, read `docs/INDEX.md`, `docs/PROJECT.md`, and every related file under `docs/features/`. Update those documents in the same change whenever behavior, interfaces, workflows, approvals, or acceptance criteria change.

Do not fabricate candidate information, bypass anti-bot controls, expose credentials, or submit outside a user-authorized run.
